item.title: Sakana AI Signs Japan Defense Intelligence Contract
item.description: Japan’s Defense Ministry hired Sakana AI to test agent-based intelligence analysis, moving sovereign AI into security operations.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 24
item.description: · Nio autonomous-driving chief Ren Shaoqing reportedly founded an embodied-intelligence startup that will receive strategic investment from Nio.（IT之家） · Netflix open-sourced an agent workflow designed to conduct causal reasoning rather than merely identify correlations in observational data.（InfoQ 中文） · Cerebras unveiled its CS-4 system, claiming twice the performance of its predecessor while retaining the same wafer-scale processor.（The Decoder） · Robert Martin said his experiment trusting AI-generated code revealed unresolved reliability problems despite substantial productivity gains.（InfoQ 中文） · An investigation found AI chatbots frequently directed pregnant users to anti-abortion websites without disclosing those sites’ ideological affiliations.（The Decoder） · Alibaba’s Wan 3.0 became available on Leonardo AI, extending the video model’s distribution to another mainstream creative platform.（X / Alibaba Wan） · Dreamina showcased Seedance 2.5 generating a surreal video whose character becomes trapped inside a CAPTCHA interface.（X / Dreamina） · MIT Technology Review examined evidence that children infer language rules more effectively than current AI systems, with the underlying reason still unresolved.（MIT Technology Review） · Alibaba DAMO Academy introduced a liver-cancer AI model reportedly capable of accurately identifying tumors as small as one centimeter.（量子位） · Zhongcheng Hualong released its HL200 inference chip alongside a supernode architecture designed to scale into clusters containing thousands of accelerators.（量子位） · Wan 3.0 launched with native 30-second video generation, synchronized audio, multimodal references and improved temporal consistency.（量子位） · A WRC presentation outlined native omni-modal world models that progress from passively simulating environments toward supporting interactive worlds.（量子位） · Together AI said GLM-5.3 completed over five times more DeepSWE work than Fable 5 under an identical $100 budget.（X / Together AI） · Sam Altman warned that concentrating control of advanced AI among too few organizations could create serious societal risks.（SiliconANGLE）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 23
item.description: · Usage data indicates Anthropic’s flagship model trails cheaper alternatives among developers despite its stronger capabilities.（Simon Willison） · Harvey introduced Tenet, a Kimi K3-based model post-trained with Fireworks for long-horizon legal-agent tasks.（MarkTechPost） · Google Cloud published guidance for giving LLM agents session state so they can preserve context and preferences across interactions.（Google Cloud Tech on X） · AWS open-sourced Dogwood to define and enforce safer, more predictable tool-calling rules for AI agents.（InfoQ 中文） · A new organizational-design proposal argues deployed AI agents need explicit roles, reporting lines and escalation paths.（SiliconANGLE） · Flock Safety’s chief executive called for compromise as opposition grows toward the company’s AI-assisted camera surveillance network.（TechCrunch） · Databricks demonstrated Unity AI Gateway for centrally tracking model, coding-agent and MCP usage, costs and access policies.（Databricks on X） · TechCrunch reviewed the unsettled legal standards governing whether copyrighted books may be copied to train AI models.（TechCrunch） · Amazon DynamoDB added native capabilities for AI-oriented search, reducing the need to maintain a separate vector database.（InfoQ 中文） · A World Robot Conference exhibit staged an immersive café where robots and people collaboratively handled service tasks.（量子位） · AI21 Labs trained a lower-cost verifier that it says matches frontier-verifier quality across agentic systems.（AI21 Labs on X） · An experimental AI company boss dismissed its first employee only after human supervisors reminded the agent of its own rules.（The Decoder） · Lovart added a branding workflow that turns an uploaded visual identity and prompt into complete commercial campaign materials.（Lovart on X） · A survey profiled Hong Kong professors commercializing embodied-AI research through robotics startups and university-linked ventures.（量子位）
